image_description: A close-up, high-resolution profile view of an African crocodile's head against a black background. The image highlights the textured, armored skin (scutes), the eye with a vertical pupil, and the interlocking teeth along the jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Teeth are clearly visible, conical, and appear to interlock correctly along the jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned on top of the skull ridge; the pupil is a vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the anatomy supports its presence.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The extreme tip of the snout is cut off by the right edge of the frame; nostrils are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and upper back shows heavy armor plating consistent with an elongated body structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is highly detailed, showing distinct, raised osteoderms with a rough appearance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration matches the description, with realistic variation in tone and heavy texturing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a side/top profile; the belly/ventral side is completely occluded or out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in this tight headshot crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not included in the frame.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out alligator or other crocodilian hybrids based on snout shape and scale pattern.
To analyze the micro-texture of the scales for signs of AI 'smearing' or repetitive pattern artifacts common in generated reptile skin.
To ensure individual teeth are distinct entities and not fused into the gum line or each other, a common failure mode in AI generation.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the eye socket and the surrounding scales; AI often blurs this boundary. Verify that the teeth do not merge into the lip line. Check for any 'waxy' sheen on the scales that might indicate a lack of true subsurface scattering.

metadata.class_label: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
